pattern.description: The emoji picker grid scrolls upward inside the rounded panel: the top row exits, the next row rises under the floating 'Search Emoji & Symbols' pill, which stays put as a frosted overlay, while a gentle push-in runs at the same time.
pattern.why_premium: The scroll decelerates smoothly (energy decays from the first frame) instead of stepping, and the frosted pill blurs the content passing beneath it, giving depth; pairing it with a slow push keeps the shot moving without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Clip the grid inside the panel (overflow: hidden). tl.to('.emoji-grid', {y: '-=150', duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}); in parallel tl.to('.stage', {scale: 1.14, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<'); keep '.search-pill' outside the grid with backdrop-filter: blur(12px) so passing tiles blur under it.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); grid translateY = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [0, -150]); stage scale = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [1, 1.14]); pill is a sibling with backdrop-filter blur, not inside the scrolled grid.

notes: Camera verdict is push_in (scale 1.14) while the grid also scrolls inside the panel; masked_scroll chosen as the dominant read, ui_camera_push_in is a plausible alternative. Search pill appears fixed relative to the panel so it is not listed.
